scope: Focused primary-source review, supplementing independent full-source cheap audits; not a replacement for them.
source_read_sections: Appendix A Process Overview and Design Concepts / Interaction / Stochasticity / Observation
Appendix A Initialization and all core exchange/dissonance/choice submodels
findings: Singular strength and dilemma flags are chosen-alternative state in Table 1; indexed strengths in Table 2 do not provide a synchronization step.
Negligible-gap and social-importance-threshold narrative passages occur in Appendix A Interaction, not Section 2; previous source locations were corrected.
Table 3 assumes perfect knowledge of all alter choices while procedures calculate from representations and refresh selected views; intended global synchronization is not given.
Cached traits have numeric zero defaults; optional/None was a false representation of initialization.
Signal and Inquire update different participants, with asymmetric aspiration terms and immediate second-party choice/dissonance updates.
Radius wording differs between Stochasticity (<36) and Create Networks (35 Euclidean cells); this must be exposed.
Inquiry rank aggregates four influence weights; printed signalling aggregation includes its own field and remains unresolved.
Inquire submodel does not give its global indicator setter despite Table 1/Observation; no setter was invented.
conclusion: Faithful extraction must stay a partial specification at missing rules. Paper inconsistencies are documented rather than replaced with mock rules.
